FragZone.io.description: An in-browser ".io"-style multiplayer shooter game (internally named "ioShooter"), built with vanilla JavaScript and HTML5 Canvas.
FragZone.io.experience: Real-time game loop and rendering fundamentals, input handling, and the performance considerations of building a fast-paced game without a game engine or framework.

NapTalk.description: A peer-to-peer web app for direct browser-to-browser voice/data connections — no central media server — with QR-code pairing and installable PWA support.
NapTalk.experience: Real-time peer-to-peer networking in the browser (WebRTC signaling and NAT traversal), decentralized state sync with GUN.js, and shipping a modern React + TypeScript + Vite app as an installable PWA.

portfolio.description: An earlier iteration of a personal portfolio site, later superseded by this one.
portfolio.experience: First pass at self-presentation online — informed the more minimal, content-first approach used for shadhin-folio.

Edge-powered-Skin-Disease-Classification.description: A semi-supervised, edge-computing dermatology assistant that turns a smartphone into an offline, privacy-preserving skin-condition classifier: 99% accuracy across four common conditions (Acne, Ringworm, Nail Fungus, Athlete's Foot), plus a GAN-based anomaly detector (75.7% F1) that flags rare/unknown cases for follow-up.
Edge-powered-Skin-Disease-Classification.experience: Full ML-to-mobile pipeline — training and evaluating a CNN classifier and a GAN anomaly detector, then compressing the model 90% via INT8 quantization for fully offline, on-device inference in a cross-platform Flutter app with secure auth.

rds2-but-from-future.description: A large, actively maintained vanilla-JS web application, rebuilt and iterated on over more than a year.
rds2-but-from-future.experience: Maintaining and scaling a large front-end codebase without a framework — DOM structure discipline, state handling by hand, and sustaining a single project across a long timeline.

Machine-Learning.description: A structured self-study journey through machine learning: data preprocessing, regression, classification, clustering, association rule learning, reinforcement learning, NLP, deep learning, dimensionality reduction, and model selection/boosting — plus an applied skin-disease test notebook.
Machine-Learning.experience: End-to-end ML workflow experience across nearly every major model family, and how to evaluate/compare models rather than relying on a single algorithm — the direct foundation for the DERM-AI project.

DSA.description: Data structures and algorithms practice — problem solving across arrays, trees, graphs, and sorting/searching techniques.
DSA.experience: Stronger algorithmic problem-solving and complexity analysis, and more fluency writing efficient, low-level C++.

design-patterns.description: Standalone implementations of classic software engineering design patterns in C++.
design-patterns.experience: Deeper theoretical grounding in creational, structural, and behavioral patterns, independent of any single project — groundwork later applied directly in DourerUpor.

DourerUpor-Tour-Package-Builder.description: A team-built (CSE327) platform for exploring, building, and sharing travel packages, with login via email, Google OAuth, and GitHub OAuth, package lifecycle states (Pending/Approved/Rejected), and follower notifications.
DourerUpor-Tour-Package-Builder.experience: Applied eight GoF design patterns in a real codebase — Strategy (pluggable login), Singleton (single DB connection), Builder (incremental package construction), Observer (follower notifications), State (package lifecycle), Decorator (dynamic page composition), Proxy (lazy image loading), and Iterator (review traversal) — plus coordinating a 4-person team on a shared repo.

Melodise.description: A PHP-based music streaming platform management system covering catalog, playback, and user-facing management features.
Melodise.experience: First large PHP backend project — server-side rendering, structuring a multi-page app, and basic database-driven CRUD flows.
